## `slides_batch_update`

Class: update

Generic presentations.batchUpdate pass-through. Accepts the full Request union (create/move/delete slides, insert text/shapes/images/tables, styling, replaceAllText, …). See https://developers.google.com/workspace/slides/api/reference/rest/v1/presentations/request

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `presentationId` | string | required | Presentation ID |
| `requests` | array | required | Array of Request objects, each with one request-type key like {createSlide: {...}} |
| `writeControl` | object | optional | Optional optimistic concurrency control |

## `slides_create`

Class: create

Create a new Google Slides presentation (starts with one blank slide)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `title` | string | required | Presentation title |

## `slides_get`

Class: read

Get a presentation as a compact summary (title, per-slide objectId + text digest). Pass full:true for the raw Presentation JSON (can be very large).

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias; "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `presentationId` | string | required | Presentation ID |
| `full` | boolean | optional | Return the untrimmed Presentation resource |

## `slides_page_get`

Class: read

Get the full JSON of one slide/page (all page elements with geometry and text)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias; "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `presentationId` | string | required | Presentation ID |
| `pageObjectId` | string | required | Page object ID (from slides_get) |

## `slides_page_thumbnail`

Class: read

Get a rendered thumbnail image URL for one slide (the contentUrl expires after ~30 minutes)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias; "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `presentationId` | string | required | Presentation ID |
| `pageObjectId` | string | required | Page object ID (from slides_get) |
| `mimeType` | enum | optional | Thumbnail mime type (default: PNG) |
| `thumbnailSize` | enum | optional | LARGE=1600px, MEDIUM=800px, SMALL=200px, WIDTH2000_PX=2000px wide (default: server-chosen) |
